comments.content: The CurrentMetrics updates are placed after the retry-exhaustion path (the `else` branch that scheduled the task and returned earlier). If `run()` has an early `return` in the failure/retry path (before retries are exhausted), the metric update will be skipped, causing the ReadonlyDisks/BrokenDisks counters to drift out of sync with the actual disk state. Please verify all code paths that change disk->readonly/disk->broken fall through to these CurrentMetrics::add calls, or move the metric reconciliation so it always runs regardless of which branch is taken.

The log message still passes disk->getName() as an argument (`{0}`), but the DiskLocal logger is now already namespaced with the disk name (getLogger(fmt::format("DiskLocal({})", name_))). Some messages were updated to drop the disk name (e.g. "Disk is readonly") while this recovery message retained it. Consider making this consistent to avoid redundant naming.
